name: When should I choose a Level 5 drywall finish?

mainEntity.name: When should I choose a Level 5 drywall finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Level 5 drywall finish is recommended when the highest quality, most uniform surface is desired. This is particularly important for areas with critical lighting conditions, such as large windows or direct artificial light, which can highlight minor imperfections. It's also essential when applying high-gloss or semi-gloss paints, which tend to accentuate surface flaws. For walls and ceilings that will be painted with dark colors, a Level 5 finish provides the best base for an unblemished appearance. It ensures a premium aesthetic, even if more time and cost are involved.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a Level 5 drywall finish for areas with critical lighting, or when using high-gloss/dark paints, to achieve the most uniform and smooth surface without imperfections.
